dog.description_text: Meet Charlie — New Arrival! Charlie just arrived and is still getting settled in, so we’re just beginning to learn who they are. Right now, everything is new—new people, new sounds, new routines—and we’re giving them time to relax, decompress, and show us their true personality at their own pace. Here’s what we know so far about his time in foster care: https://bestfriends.sharepoint.com/:b:/r/sites/GRP_NYC_Foster/Shared%20Documents/Forms/AllItems.aspx?id=%2Fsites%2FGRP%5FNYC%5FFoster%2FShared%20Documents%2FGeneral%2FCharlie%20%2D%20About%20Me%2Epdf&parent=%2Fsites%2FGRP%5FNYC%5FFoster%2FShared%20Documents%2FGeneral&p=true&share=cQoUSiAi0NoWTLEUVxaDEr5CEgUD%2DyRyeICzDgUHQFM08VUanw His foster says "first week he was very nonchalant, was very cuddly at first. Slept in bed with us first night! He loves pets and will nuzzle on you, he has recently started showing his playful side. He loves treats and is very food motivated ...he gets reallly cuddly and purrs very quiet. he is very food motivated and will be interested is anything you are eating ...he likes to climb on things and loves butt scratches." He is neutered, vaccinated, microchipped, and has had preventative treatments to ensure he is ready for his next steps. Submit an adoption survey from above and our team will reach out via phone or email (check spam) to schedule a counseling call. Please remember, pets cannot be held or reserved.
